==English==

===Alternative forms===
* {{alter|en|reäction||rare}}

===Etymology===
{{etymon|en|id=response}}
{{root|en|ine-pro|*h₂eǵ-|id=drive}}
{{inh+|en|enm|reaccion}}, from {{der|en|fro|reaction}}, from {{uder|en|la|reāctiō}}, from the verb {{m|la|reagō}}, from {{m|la|re-||again}} + {{m|la|agō||to act}}; more at {{m|en|re-}}, {{m|en|action}}; equivalent to {{suffix|en|react|ion}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{audio|en|en-us-reaction.ogg|a=US}}
* {{IPA|en|/ɹiˈækʃən/}}
* {{rhymes|en|ækʃən|s=3}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}

# An [[action]] or [[statement]] in [[response]] to a [[stimulus]] or other [[event]].
#: {{ux|en|The announcement of the verdict brought a violent '''reaction'''.}}
#: {{ux|en|You were in the courtroom. What is your '''reaction'''?}}
#: {{ux|en|When I last tried to eat strawberries I had a terrible allergic '''reaction'''.}}
# {{lb|en|chemistry}} A [[transformation]] in which one or more [[substance]]s is [[convert]]ed into another by [[combination]] or [[decomposition]].
#: {{ux|en|In this '''reaction''', the acid and base will neutralize each other, producing a salt.}}
# {{lb|en|politics}} [[reactionary|Reactionary]] [[politics]]; a period in which reactionary thought or politics is resurgent or dominant.
# {{lb|en|Misesian praxeology|[[w:Austrian school of economics|Austrian economics]]}} [[unpurposeful|Unpurposeful]] behavior.
# {{lb|en|internet}} An [[icon]] or [[emoji]] appended to a posted message by a [[user]] to express their feeling about it.
